profiles.notes: Master of Business Administration. Graduate entry from a prior bachelor degree; not a school-leaver or doctoral threshold. CV, recommendation and possible interview conditions shared by the three reviewed graduate programmes remain in their explicitly named common scope. No application year is published.

requirements.label: Prior degree and academic standing
requirements.details: A recognized bachelor degree is required, with either cumulative GPA of at least 3.0 on a 4.0 scale or upper second-class honours under the named US/UK/UWI scales. The page does not establish a general conversion between every national grading system.

source.title: University of Belize MBA: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: Graduate personal-statement instructions
requirements.details: The personal statement must explain reasons for applying, preparation for the field and career alignment, and relevant background/interests. It must be typed in APA format and no longer than two pages. The undergraduate 250–500-word prompt is not substituted for this programme instruction.

source.title: University of Belize MBA: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: MBA professional-experience minimum
requirements.details: At least three years of professional work experience is required for the MBA. The programme page does not restrict this to a named industry or publish an identical duration rule for Educational Leadership or MPhil.

requirements.label: MPhil research-proposal instructions
requirements.details: Submit the research proposal requested by the programme panel. It asks for reasons for applying, preparation for the field, career alignment, relevant background and interests, with a maximum of two typed pages in APA format. These are the published panel instructions, not an invented full thesis-proposal word count.

source.title: University of Belize MPhil: Admission Requirements

profiles.notes: Shared conditions cross-checked on the MBA, Educational Leadership and MPhil official admissions pages. Each fact names the programmes to which it applies; this is not an assertion that all future graduate awards have identical conditions.

requirements.label: CV for the three reviewed graduate programmes
requirements.details: MBA, Educational Leadership and MPhil each request a recent resume/CV. This common rule applies to those three reviewed programmes; it is not copied into their individual scopes or extended to every future graduate award.

source.title: University of Belize MBA: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: Graduate recommendations: count not specified
requirements.details: MBA, Educational Leadership and MPhil each request acceptable recommendations. Their reviewed web panels do not specify a universal number or recommender occupations. The undergraduate two-form requirement is not automatically extended to these graduate programmes.

source.title: University of Belize MPhil: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: Possible graduate admissions interview
requirements.details: For MBA, Educational Leadership and MPhil, an interview may be required before the final admissions decision. The wording is conditional, not a claim that every applicant will be interviewed.

source.title: University of Belize Educational Leadership: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: Job letter for MBA and Educational Leadership
requirements.details: The MBA and Educational Leadership application-material panels require a job letter. This named-programme condition is not applied to MPhil, and a job letter alone does not establish an unstated number of years of teaching or management experience.

source.title: University of Belize Educational Leadership: Admission Requirements

profiles.notes: International conditions for this named graduate programme only. They are separate from the prior-degree/academic requirements and shared graduate application materials. The page is undated and does not confirm a currently open cycle.

requirements.label: International English evidence
requirements.details: The programme requires English-competency evidence: TOEFL at least 87, IELTS at least 5, or an equivalent qualification. The web panel does not identify a TOEFL edition, IELTS module, component scores or IB-English waiver; confirm the matching accepted test/version.

source.title: University of Belize Educational Leadership: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: International credential evaluation
requirements.details: Provide an official report from a reputable credential-evaluation service. The programme panel names Josef Silny and WES; it does not establish a complete exclusive list of every accepted service.

source.title: University of Belize Educational Leadership: Admission Requirements

requirements.label: First-term payment and unresolved timing
requirements.details: The international programme panel lists full payment of first-trimester or first-semester tuition and fees. It gives no amount or precise offer/registration/payment stage. Confirm the applicable timing before acting; this is not an instruction to pay before an admissions decision.
